subject: Shiny Markdown example on website does not work locally

messages.author: f1c24acf3f7976bb
messages.subject: Shiny Markdown example on website does not work locally
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to get this example to work:

http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/download-knitr-reports.html

Copying the ui.R and server.R files exactly locally, I get the following error:


Warning in normalizePath("report.Rmd") :
  path[1]="report.Rmd": No such file or directory
Error in tools::file_path_as_absolute(input) :
  file 'report.Rmd' does not exist

What am I missing?

Thanks!

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Markdown example on website does not work locally
parts:
If you want to get the source code of the app on shiny.rstudio.com,
please hit the button "Get code" on the top, instead of copying the
code displayed on the app page.

Regards,
Yihui
